title: Add user role names and doubt Q&A system

requirements.summary: Capture and store user names during role setup after login
acceptanceCriteria: Users must provide their name when setting up their profile after first login
Names are stored in the user profile in the backend
Names are displayed throughout the application when referencing users

file_operations.description: Update the RoleSetupModal to include a name input field alongside the role selection. The form should collect both name and role (Junior or Senior) before calling useSaveCallerUserProfile with the complete UserProfile object. Use the authorization component's profile setup pattern to ensure the name is captured during first-time user onboarding. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the Layout component to display the user's name in the header using the userProfile data from useGetCallerUserProfile. Show the name next to the user avatar or in a profile section, replacing or supplementing any principal display. Ensure the name is visible when authenticated and a profile exists.

requirements.summary: Enable Junior users to post doubts with description and optional attachments
acceptanceCriteria: Junior users can access a doubt posting form
Doubts include a text description field
Optional image attachments can be uploaded with doubts
Posted doubts appear in the main doubts feed

file_operations.description: Verify that the DoubtForm supports text description and optional image upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob from the blob-storage component. The form should use usePostDoubt hook for submission. Ensure the form is only accessible to Junior users by checking userProfile.role === UserRole.Junior in the parent component.

Update the DoubtsPage to conditionally render the DoubtForm in the sidebar only for Junior users (userProfile.role === UserRole.Junior). For Senior users, display an informational message explaining they can answer doubts but cannot post them. Ensure the role check uses the userProfile from useGetCallerUserProfile.

requirements.summary: Enable Senior users to answer doubts with text, notes, and video attachments
acceptanceCriteria: Senior users can view all posted doubts
Senior users can submit answers with text explanations
Answers can include optional notes and video attachments
Answers are displayed under the corresponding doubt

file_operations.description: Verify that the AnswerForm supports text input, optional notes file upload, and optional video file upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob from the blob-storage component. The form should use usePostAnswer hook for submission. Ensure proper file type validation for notes and video attachments.

Update the DoubtDetailPage to conditionally render the AnswerForm only for Senior users (userProfile.role === UserRole.Senior). For Junior users, hide the answer form or display a message indicating only Senior users can answer. Ensure the role check uses the userProfile from useGetCallerUserProfile and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Display user names throughout the application UI
acceptanceCriteria: Doubt author names are shown on doubt cards
Answer author names are shown on answer cards
User names appear in the header when logged in
Names are displayed on the leaderboard

file_operations.description: Update DoubtCard to fetch and display the author's name using useGetUserProfile hook with the doubt's author Principal. Show the author's name prominently in the card header or metadata section. Handle loading and error states gracefully, falling back to a truncated principal display if the profile is unavailable.

Update AnswerCard to fetch and display the responder's name using useGetUserProfile hook with the answer's responder Principal. Show the responder's name prominently in the card header or metadata section. Handle loading and error states gracefully, falling back to a truncated principal display if the profile is unavailable.

Update LeaderboardTable to fetch and display user names for each leaderboard entry using useGetUserProfile hook with the entry's userId Principal. Replace or supplement the principal display with the user's name in each table row. Handle loading states with skeletons and gracefully handle missing profiles.

Ensure the Layout header displays the logged-in user's name from userProfile.name (already fetched via useGetCallerUserProfile). The name should be visible in the user profile section of the header, providing clear identification of the current user. This complements the name display added in REQ-1.
